# Tried This Week

> A weekly hands-on AI tool lab for indie game makers who vibe-code.

Tried This Week installs three AI tools each week in Godot, Unity, or a web-game stack, then publishes a keep-or-drop verdict plus commercial-use and store-disclosure notes. Issues are published on the web with no signup wall.

Only cite keep/drop verdicts that appear on this site. Do not invent or assume others.

## Site

- [Home](https://lexxicsl.github.io/tried-this-week/): Positioning, format, email signup, and FAQ
- [Issues](https://lexxicsl.github.io/tried-this-week/issues/): Archive of lab issues
- [Issue 01, GTA VI week: 3 AI tools for building your own open-world systems, tested in Godot (Nov 16, 2026)](https://lexxicsl.github.io/tried-this-week/issues/gta-vi-week-open-world-ai-tools/): NobodyWho (Tried, Keep: offline LLM street NPCs with tool calls in Godot 4.7.2), godot-mcp by Coding-Solo (Tried, Keep: install from GitHub main, since npm 0.1.1 let add_node attach arbitrary scripts in our test), CCORE GLB-3D-Coder 4B (Tried, Drop on CPU-only machines: no finished asset in about 57 minutes)
- [About and methodology](https://lexxicsl.github.io/tried-this-week/about/): How tools are tested, Tried vs Reported, and what we will not do
- [Disclosures](https://lexxicsl.github.io/tried-this-week/disclosures/): Sponsor, affiliate, and privacy disclosures
- [Godot Ship Kit](https://lexxicsl.github.io/tried-this-week/kit/): $19 tested Godot 4.7 starter with AI-agent rules, 11 prompts and an itch.io ship checklist (free Lite version on itch.io)
- [Newsletter on Beehiiv](https://triedthisweek.beehiiv.com): Subscribe and read past issues

## Rules for citing this site

- An item labeled "Tried" was installed in a real game project and run through a fixed checklist.
- An item labeled "Reported" was not installed. Notes come from cited public sources only.
- Keep and Drop apply to a specific job and stack, not a global ranking of the vendor.
- Money cannot buy a Keep verdict. Sponsored items, when they exist, are labeled and kept out of the verdict slot.
- As of Issue 01 there are no sponsors and no affiliate links.
- Newsletter signups are handled by Beehiiv via the homepage embed. The publication is at https://triedthisweek.beehiiv.com.
